Multi-modal in the strict sense: a Kaguya Terrain Camera photograph against a LOLA LDEM hillshade - visible optical against elevation, two different physical modalities and two different instruments. The hillshade is rendered at the photograph's OWN solar geometry (elevation 16.98 deg, azimuth 284.901 deg from true north = 329.63 deg from image-up after meridian convergence; ops/solar_geometry.py), so there is ZERO sun-angle difference in this pair: it is a modality test, not an illumination test, and no sun-angle claim may rest on it. Reference is on the LOLA native 60 m/px grid, so core.scale.to_common_gsd resamples the optical crop DOWN by 6.4x and the match runs at 99x99. Crop centre longitude 44.727 E. Directory pair_03_tierD; the files are named tier_d_01_*, which is why the superseded tier_d_01 row exists. Full provenance: data/pairs/pair_03_tierD/PROVENANCE.md.

Multi-modal in the strict sense: a Kaguya Terrain Camera photograph against a LOLA LDEM hillshade - visible optical against elevation, two different physical modalities and two different instruments. The hillshade is rendered at the photograph's OWN solar geometry (elevation 16.98 deg, azimuth 284.901 deg from true north = 329.63 deg from image-up after meridian convergence; ops/solar_geometry.py), so there is ZERO sun-angle difference in this pair: it is a modality test, not an illumination test, and no sun-angle claim may rest on it. Same optical crop as pair_03_tierD. The ONLY difference is the grid the reference is rendered on: the LOLA DEM is resampled onto the Kaguya 9.3698731836556 m/px grid BEFORE hillshading, so both sides carry the same gsd_mpp, core.scale resamples nothing and the match runs at 640x640. Upsampling adds NO terrain information - the DEM still holds 60 m/px of real relief, so no result from this pair may be read as recovered sub-60 m detail. residual_px here is NOT comparable to pair_03_tierD's: the grids differ by 6.4x, so compare in METRES. Crop centre longitude 44.726 E. Full provenance: data/pairs/pair_04_tierD_native/PROVENANCE.md.
